_readme: Local overrides for what Cal.com cannot supply. Services are keyed by Cal.com event slug. Category order and the order of slugs inside a category set the page order. See the README section 'Services menu'.

guard._note: Any service whose slug or name contains one of these words must be coming-soon, or the build stops.

categories.name: Consultation
categories.intro: A short, free conversation before you book anything else.

categories.name: Face
categories.intro: Unhurried facials, shaped around your skin on the day.

categories.name: Wax
categories.intro: Quick, careful hair removal, with your comfort first.

15min.name: Skin Discovery Call
15min.description: A complimentary 15-minute virtual chat about your skin goals and which CALÉIRA service fits you best. This is not a medical consultation.

image.alt: Kim, the founder of CALÉIRA, smiling in a white CALÉIRA top against a soft cream wall.

60min.name: CALÉIRA Signature Facial
60min.description: A personalized European-inspired facial that cleanses, exfoliates, hydrates, and nourishes. Includes a customized skin assessment, gentle exfoliation, a relaxing facial massage, a targeted mask, and finishing skincare.
60min.idealFor: Guests who want fresh, healthy-looking skin and a steady skincare routine.

image.alt: A soft brush sweeping a glossy mask across a guest's cheek, eyes closed.

caleira-brazilian-wax.name: CALÉIRA Brazilian Wax
caleira-brazilian-wax.description: A professional Brazilian wax that emphasizes precision, hygiene, comfort, and discretion, leaving skin feeling smooth and well cared for.
caleira-brazilian-wax.idealFor: Guests who want consistent grooming and lasting smoothness.

image.alt: Gloved hands smoothing warm golden wax along a guest's lower leg with a wooden spatula.

dormant._note: Not rendered. Move an entry back into categories and services to restore it. Dormant slugs are ignored by the build, including the unplaced warning.

categories.name: Massage
categories.intro: Slow hands and full attention, from first touch to last.

image.alt: A provider cradling a guest's neck and shoulder with both hands in a candlelit room.

categories.name: Body
categories.intro: Hands-on sculpting sessions for the body, calm and unhurried.
categories.note: Body contouring is cosmetic. Individual experiences vary.

image.alt: Two hands smoothing cream across a guest's shoulder beside a folded white towel.

caleira-facial-sculpt.name: CALÉIRA Facial Sculpt
caleira-facial-sculpt.description: A sculpting facial with targeted massage techniques and deep hydration, designed to leave you feeling relaxed with a refreshed, rested look.
caleira-facial-sculpt.idealFor: Special events and a little extra facial relaxation.

caleira-executive-grooming.name: CALÉIRA Executive Grooming
caleira-executive-grooming.description: A quick, polished grooming visit with professional eyebrow shaping and your choice of upper-lip or chin waxing, finished with soothing post-wax care.
caleira-executive-grooming.idealFor: Busy professionals who want a polished look without a long appointment.

signature-massage.name: CALÉIRA Signature Massage
signature-massage.description: A 90-minute full-body massage tailored to your pressure and preferences. Launching soon.

sculpt-360.name: CALÉIRA Sculpt 360
sculpt-360.description: A personalized body-care experience that pairs studio-grade technology with calm, unhurried care. Launching soon.
